title: An AlNbTiVZr0.5 high-entropy alloy combining high specific strength and good ductility
process_description: prepared by arc melting of high-purity elements (≥99.9 at%) in an argon atmosphere inside a water-cooled copper cavity. The ingot was remelted 5 times. After casting, the alloy was homogenized at 1200 °C for 24 h in vacuum and cooled down on air.
